svg.title: Inside tsr_core
svg.desc: tsr_core v2 in two clock domains. In the clk_rv domain, drawn planned: the Ibex RV32IMC control core with ITCM, DTCM, a debug module and the control window. Clock domain crossings connect it to the core clock domain: tsr_csr with the launch queue, completion ring and log ring, the issue FIFO, the checker tsr_chk and the dispatcher with one in-order queue per unit. The units are the DMA (LD, ST), QACT, the MVM clusters and a planned vector unit; all use the 4 MiB tsr_spm. One tsr_mem_arb per channel merges the DMA and weight-stream traffic onto that channel's memory port.
